predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not a verified exact reconstruction. Used 24 business requests and 10 REA operations, including inspection. Successful estimate and alias responses reported roundingCents=100000; all three attempted approved requests were denied. Observations at adjacent quantities 571 and 572 locate an observed downward pricing transition. The predictor uses a parsimonious proportional-price model on either side. Its slopes are the midpoints of the feasible slope intervals under nearest-100000-cent rounding and zero fixed fees: approximately [1807.229, 1838.879) before the transition and [766.088, 782.609) afterward. Every successful observed quotation is consistent with this model after that coarse rounding. The exact slopes, possible fixed fees or curvature, and additional unobserved transitions remain unidentified; the coefficient precision does not imply exact-price certainty.
